description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Pawn of Ulamog and Mimic Vat trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Mimic Vat trigger, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
